Here's my recipe and nutrition facts on myfitnesspal:

http://www.myfitnesspal.com/recipe/view/125212796210941

How to cook:

  1. Pre-heat oven to 450F
  2. Put 1 cup almond four in a bowl, add spices to taste (I use onion powder, garlic powder, basil, oregano, & red peppers). Set bowl aside.
  3. Heat 1.5 cups mozzarella cheese for two minutes in microwave
  4. Combine heated cheese with 1 cup almond flour & 1 large egg - mix until you have a sticky dough.
  5. Using a piece of parchment paper (the dough is very sticky) spread out into a nice thin crust (I can usually get a solid 12" or more). Also, wet your hands wile spreading to keep the dough from sticking.
  6. Leaving the crust on the parchment, place on pizza pan, and cook in oven, mid rack, for 8 minutes.
  7. Remove from oven, and flip crust using a large spatula.
  8. Add toppings... I use a small can of tomato paste (watch out for sugar in regular pizza sauce!), mozzarella cheese, pepperonis, diced peppers (red, green, yellow, makes it pretty, lol), and freshly sliced jalapenos.
  9. Stick the whole thing back in the oven for 8 minutes. Move it to the top rack to really blast the toppings, cook for another 2 minutes.
  10. Remove from oven and gasp in awe at the masterpiece you have just created.

Note... this is not low calorie, it's low carb. Each slice is gonna be about 250 calories. But, it's really filling... I tend to really pile on the diced peppers... even my big ass usually gets full after 2 slices. I put the rest in the fridge, and reheat it in the microwave for about 1 minute when I'm ready for more.
